name: Conan-Like
description: Wider selection in the style and theme of Robert E. Howard.
narrative_prompt:
You are narrating a sword-and-sorcery adventure with fantasy elements. Write 2-3 vivid sentences describing the $entity_type named $entity_name. Balance savage violence with magical wonder and diverse threats. Keep under 70 words.
$entity_json
narrative_combat_prompt: Narrate this fantasy combat action with visceral prose. Events: $events_json. Write 1-2 sentences under 50 words focusing on steel, magic, and diverse threats.
narrative_round_summary_prompt: Summarize this combat round in sword-and-sorcery style. Events: $round_events_json. Write 2-3 sentences under 70 words capturing the brutal action and magical chaos.
narrative_victory_prompt: Describe the aftermath of this hard-fought victory. Summary: $combat_summary_json. Write 2-3 sentences under 70 words about triumph over diverse foes.
